tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga yon tan kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ gu ru pū tsa bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas yon tan rab rdzogs kun mkhyen ye shes thugs// rnam grol zhi ba'i gsung gis ma rig mun pa sel// bsod nams mchog gis brgyan pa'i gzi brjid dpal 'bar ba'i// dpal ldan rin chen zhabs la gus pas spyi bos 'dud// dpal ldan ye shes yon tan bsam mi khyab// de la gus pas mchod cing bstod pa yi// bsod nams yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas// yon tan kun 'byung cho ga bshad par bya// de yang sdom pa 'byung ba las// mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs la// bla ma'i mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// bla med mdzad pa'i slob dpon ni// rdo rje sems dpar rab mchod na// de yis bsod nams ma byas shing*// dka' thub ma brten ci zhig yod// mtshan brjod las kyang de bzhin du// mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas// rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os// bkur 'os brjod par bya ba'i mchog /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab// de sogs yon tan dran byas la// bla ma mchog las sangs rgyas su// mthong ba'i mos gus dam pa yis// bla ma mchod la brtson par bya// dngos su bzhugs na bla ma mchog /gang dang gang la mnyes pas mchod// 'das sam gzhan na bzhugs gyur kyang*// dngos su bzhugs dang khyad med par// gus pa'i yid kyis bsam byas la// maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba yis// ci 'byor rdzas dang brtan g.yo'i tshogs// thams cad blo yis blangs la 'bul// de yi rim pa 'di yin te// dang po lha yi rnal 'byor gyi// blo ldan rdo rje gsor byed cing*// dril bu dkrol bar brtson pa yis// lha dang lha min bsrung ba dang*// bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs bskrad// de nas blo ldan sngags pa yis// rten dang brten par bcas pa bskyed// spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol nas kyang*// phyi nang gsang sogs mchod pa dang*// bstod pa rnams kyis yang dag bstod// sdig bshags bsdo ba'i bar du bya// de yi rim la 'di yin ste/

hūm̐/ rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa yis// sems can thams cad bsgral bar bya// rnam thar chos su byed pa ste// snying po mchog gi rdo rje gzung*// ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ āḥ shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis// 'gro ba rnams ni sad pa'i bdag /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi// sems can don phyir dkrol par bya// dharma gaṇ+ḍe āḥ ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas// mnyam par bzhag pa hūm̐ gi lus// phyogs bcu kun tu bsgrag bya ste// shes rab thabs kyi sgra sgrog bya// hūm̐ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lus srul la sogs gang yang rung*/ bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// ci ste ngas bsgo su zhig 'da'// rdo rje'i bdag po sku yis ni// lus srul la sogs 'gas bya ste// 'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// hūm̐ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur zhing*// phrin las kun gyi bdag po ru// nga ni rjes su gnang ba ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /gal te bka' las 'das pa na// brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// bla ma'i rjes su mi 'jug cing*// dkon mchog gsum la ma dad pa// gang dag ji snyed yod pa kun// myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig/ hūm̐ bzhi la sogs drag sngags kyis/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dra ba bya// de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis mchod rdzas rnams bsangs la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi d+ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod cing byin gyis brlab bar bya'o// de nas zhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed la/ hūm̐/ 'gro mgon thugs rje'i spyan ldan rnams// chos sku spros dang bral ba las// gzugs sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas kyang*/

'gro ba'i don la gshegs su gsol// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ta ga ta e h+ye hi bha ga wa na mahā ka ru ṇi ka hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ mgon po 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta pra war sad ka ra mahā sad ka ra mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes zhal bsil dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// de bzhin dag pa lha yi chu// dag pa yis ni sku khrus gsol// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta mahā pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes zhabs bsil dbul/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma la ye staṃ/ zhes gdan la bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi ma rig mun pa'i tshogs/ smag tu gyur pa sel mdzad pa// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi// tshad gdung ma lus sel mdzad pa// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi 'dod chags la sogs pa'i// nyon mongs nad rnams sel mdzad pa// sman pa'i rgyal po lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi zag med bde chen gyi// grong khyer mchog tu skyel mdzad pa// rta mchog rin chen lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi skye rga na 'chi yi// chu bo che las sgrol mdzad pa// mnyan pa'i rgyal po lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod dag

/yid bzhin rdzogs par 'byung 'gyur ba'i// nor bu rin chen lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi chos rnams thams cad kun// 'du 'bral med par khyab gyur pa// nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs mnga' ba'i// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis gsung gi 'od zer gyis// bdag sogs rmongs pa ma lus pa// snying gi pad+mo kha 'byed pa'i// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'chang ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// de nas phyi'i mchod pa ni// bde mchog rtsa rgyud las// gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na// dri dang de bzhin me tog spos// mar me brgya yang dbul bya zhing*// cho ga bzhin du de bzhin mchod// ces 'byung bas// dngos su 'byor dang blo yis blangs te dbul ba ni/ hūm̐/ pad+mo ut+pa la dang ku mut+ta// puṇ+ḍa ri ka la sogs me tog rigs// kha dog dbyibs legs dri gsung ldan pa kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la dbul bar bgyi// o gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// a ka ru dang du ru ka la sogs// zhing khams kun tu spos ngad ldang gyur pa'i// 'jig rten bdug spos mchog gyur ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la dbul bar bgyi// dhu pe/ 'bru mar snying po mar gyi mar me dang*// rtswi shing 'dam bu 'od ma'i sgron me sogs// 'jig rten mun sel snang byed ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la dbul bar bgyi// ā lo ke ga bur tsan dan gur gum la sogs pa'i// lhan cig skyes dang de bzhin sbyar ba yi// dri mchog byug spos reg na bde ba kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la dbul bar bgyi// gan+dhe/ 'bras chan dag dang de bzhin gtsang ma'i bshos// sna tshogs g.yos kyi bye brag dpag med pa// sbyar ba'i zhal zas ro mchog ldan pa kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la dbul bar bgyi// nai wi d+ya/

rnga chen dung dang rdza rnga pa ṭa ha// sil snyan pheg rdob la sogs rol mo'i tshogs// 'jig rten sgra dbyangs snyan pa ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la dbul bar bgyi// shap+ta pu tsa me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes so// sku gsung thugs kyi bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ sku la tshad med bgrang du med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur cing*// sna tshogs dbang phyug mi shigs pa/rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// thams cad stong pa'i cho 'phrul las// 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid rang byung dpal// sgyu 'phrul chen po che ba'i bdag /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// dngos med dngos kun bdag nyid can// gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa'i mchog /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ thog mtha' 'gro 'ong mi mnga' zhing*/ skye 'jig 'du 'bral mi mnga' yang*/ 'gro don cir yang ston mdzad pa'i// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam sprul sgyu ma'i skur bstan nas// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar mdzad cing*// rnam grol 'bras bu ster mdzad pa'i// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku yi rnam sprul re res kyang*// sems can khams ni dpag med pa'i// dgos 'dod yid bzhin skong mdzad pa// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji srid 'khor ba de srid du// sku yi mdzad pa rgyun mi chad// thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'gro ba 'dren// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ brjod du med pa'i ngang nyid las// tshangs pa la sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs// phyogs bcu kun tu sgrog mdzad pa// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// srid gsum 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// rna ba'i dbang po tshim mdzad cing*// thams cad yid dang mthun gyur pa'i// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung gi brjod pa re res kyang*// ma rig mun pa sel mdzad cing*// thar pa'i lam mchog ston mdzad pa'i// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhi sogs las rnams thams cad kun// zhal nas brjod pa tsam gyis ni// tshul bzhin du ni 'grub gyur pa'i// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// zab cing rgya che'i gsung dbyangs kyis// the tshom drwa ba gcod mdzad cing*// yid bde dang ba ster mdzad pa'i// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod thams cad kun// thugs rje'i chen po'i smon lam gyis// phun sum tshogs par 'byung 'gyur ba'i// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung gi rnam sprul rang byung gsung*// nam mkha' la sogs dngos rnams la// chos kyi sgra ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/

phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// rtog pa kun las rnam par grol// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bsam gyis mi khyab dpag tu med// tshad med gzhal du med gyur cing*// mnyam pa med cing dpe med pa'i// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus kun// nyid kyi thugs su mkhyen gyur cing*// mkha' ltar dri ma mi mnga' ba'i// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten spyod pa sna tshogs kun// kun rdzob sgyu ma ltar gzigs shing*// skye 'jig ched par mkhyen gyur pa'i// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum shes bya ma lus kun// skye ba med cing gzhi med par// skad cig nyid la mkhyen gyur pa'i// ye shes= skye ba med cing 'gag pa med// dmigs med rab tu mi gnas pa// mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid can// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam dag spros dang bral ba'i thugs// skyon spangs thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad pa po// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mchod pa dbul ba ni/ hūm̐/ nam mkha' nyi zla gza' skar 'ja' tshon dang*// mdzes pa'i sprin dang khug sna la sogs pas// rab tu brgyan cing yid rab dang gyur pa// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// ri bo mchog dang de bzhin ri phran dang*// gangs ri sman ri rin chen ri bo sogs// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i ri gzhan ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen sa gzhi lo tog smin byed cing*// skyed mos tshal dang kun dga' ra ba dang*// gtsug lag khang sogs pho brang gzhir gyur pa// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// gzhal med khang chen bsil khang sgo khang dang*// rta babs la sogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// ngo mtshar mchog tu gyur pa ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// gtsug lag khang dang rgyal po'i pho brang dang*// mkhar dang yul 'khor grong dang grong khyer dang*// yid 'ong mdzes pa'i khang bzang ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi/

bla bre gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*/ dar dpyangs lhab lhub phan dang lda ldi dang*/ yol ba la sogs bkod pa'i khyad par rnams/ skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi/ gser dngul zangs lcags de bzhin mu tig dang*/ bai ḍu r+ya dang dung dang man shel dang*// byi ru la sogs rin chen ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// rgya mtsho che dang chu bo chu phran dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu mig sogs// rnyog pa med cing yan lag brgyad ldan chab// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// lo tog rtsi tog shing tog ji snyed pa'i// dri dang ro ldan 'gro ba'i gsos gyur pa// dbang po'i spyod yul ngo mtshar sna tshogs pa// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// tsan dan ga bur gur gum la sogs te// ro dang nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// nad sel sman gyi rnam pa ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// rgyu mchog rkyen gyis legs par sbyar ba yi// bza' dang bca' dang ldag dang btung la sogs// 'jig rten zas mchog ma lus ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// 'jig rten dag na na bza'i mchog gyur pa// khyad 'phags sku la 'jam zhing mdzes pa yi// bye brag dpag med ji snyed yod pa kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// sku bzhi'i ngo bo bla ma bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ kun rtog thams cad rnam spangs pa// ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron// dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med// stong nyid snying po khyod la bstod// kun mkhyen ye shes snying po can// skyon rnams kun dang bral gyur cing*// yon tan thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i mi shes bcad nas su// de nyid dag pa ston mdzad cing*/ bdag med chos la kun 'byung ba'i// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan dag

/mgon po khyod las byung ba ste// byang chub sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod// dkon mchog gsum dang theg pa che// khams gsum de dag thams cad kyi// brtan dang g.yo ba khyod las byung*// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba'i 'dod pa don grub phyir// yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'byung zhing*// dpal ldan bde gshegs ye shes gnas// sangs rgyas sras po phyag 'tshal bstod// chos dbyings dmigs med rnams dag cing*// rang bzhin dri med khyod las kyang*// sna tshogs dpag med sprul mdzad pa// 'gro ba'i skyabs chen khyod la bstod//

nang bcud kyi sems can 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ lha yi dbang po nye ba'i dbang po dang*// bu dang bu mo mdzes pa'i 'khor dang bcas// longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs bcas de dag kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// lha min klu dang gnod sbyin dri za dang*// dbang po la sogs bu dang bu mo dang*// 'khor dang longs spyod ngo mtshar ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal mi yi dbang phyug mchog /btsun mo sras bcas rin chen sna bdun dang*// dpung gi tshogs dang bcas pa ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// rgyal phran la sogs skyes pa bud med dang*// khye'u bu mo mdzes pa'i gos gyon cing*// rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa de dag kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// seng ge khyu mchog la sogs stobs chen dang*// e n+ya ya sogs mdzes pa'i ri dwags tshogs// nags khrod ri bo'i sul na rgyu ba kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// rta dang glang po de bzhin shing rta dang*// 'jig rten dag na theg chen bzhon pa'i mchog /shugs chen mgyogs par 'gro ba de dag kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// mkha' lding rgyal po ka la ping ka dang*// khu byug rma bya khrung khrung ngur pa sogs// skad snyan mdzes pa'i 'dab chags ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// lha mi'i longs spyod yongs su bzung ba dang*// yongs su bzung min rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs// ngo mtshar spyad du rung ba ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// snod kyi 'jig rten pho brang gzhal yas khang*// bcud kyi sems can sna tshogs sprul pa'i rigs// yid 'ong mdzes pa'i rol mo ji snyed kun// skyes mchog rin chen rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad dang*// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// skyes mchog khyed kyi 'bangs su 'bul lags na// thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes te skyabs du gsol//

sku bzhi rnam dag gi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med// sha dang rus pa khrag kyang med// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar// khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sku la snyun med mi gtsang med/ bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang*/ khyod ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir/ 'jig rten bya ba ston par mdzad/ dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ chu zla bzhin du bzung du med// chos rnams kun la gnas pa med// nga rgyal med cing rmongs pa med// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims// spyod lam dag ni thams cad du// khyod ni rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa'i// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// rdzu 'phrul chen po rnam 'phrul zhing*// sna tshogs smin la snyoms 'jug pa'i// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing*// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur la// 'dod pa rnams kyi ma gos pa'i// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang*// skye mched rnams la mi rten cing*// phyin ci log las rnam grol ba'i// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med// thugs ni rab tu mi gnas pa// bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing*// spros med gos pa med pa ltar// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas nang gi mchod pa ni// gsang 'dus las/ rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas// sangs rgyas tshul bzhin mchod par bya// mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis// sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga 'phul ba ni/ hūm̐/

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na// gzugs mchog rgyal ba'i spyan la mdzes pa kun// rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su rnam sprul te// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ gu ru maṇ+ḍal de wa ta ba badz+ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na// sgra mchog rgyal ba'i snyan la 'jebs pa kun// rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su rnam sprul te// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi// badz+ra shap+ta/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na// dri mchog rgyal ba'i thugs la bde ba kun// rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs su rnam sprul te// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi// badz+ra gan dhe/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na// ro mchog rgyal ba'i ljags la bda' ba kun// rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su rnam sprul te// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi// badz+ra rā s+ye/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na// reg mchog rgyal ba'i sku la 'jam pa kun// rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su rnam sprul te// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ gu ru maṇ+ḍa la de wa ta badz+ra par+she pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā// pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid kyis// pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs shing*// sa bcur gnas shing gshegs pa po// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtong ba gsum la ma rmongs shing*/ rab tu dga' ba gnas kyi mchog /'jigs med rdo rje brtan pa'i thugs// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shing nye ba'i gnas mchog dri ma med// rnam dag rdo rje skyon dang bral// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// yang dag zhing ni 'od byed pa// sgrib med rdo rje'i yon tan ldan// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba// thogs med rdo rje nam mkha'i thugs// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// tshan dho ha ni spyang dka' ba// shin tu sbyangs pa'i ye shes thugs// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// nye ba'i tshan dho mngon du gyur// sgro 'dogs chod pas the tshom bral// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// thabs kyi pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// 'du ba ring ngu song ba ste// theg dman sa las 'das pa po// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// stobs kyi pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba// rang don rlung gis mi bskyod pa'i// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// smon lam pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros sa// zab cing rgya che'i thugs mnga' ba'i// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes pha rol phyin rdzogs shing*// nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin// shes brjod yul las 'das pa po// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs dang*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas// rten dang brten pa kun 'dus pa'i// rin chen mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod//

de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni// gsang 'dus las/ dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis// bdag gi khu ba la sogs pas// cho ga bzhin du kun mchod na// sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i don rig ma bcu drug 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog sngon mo pi wang sgra sgrog cing*// rab tu mdzes ma rdo rje dril bu'i phyag /bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// oṃ āḥ badz+ra wī ni hūm̐/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog ser mo gling bu'i sgra sgrog cing*// rab tu mdzes ma rdo rje dril bu'i phyag /bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// waṃ she/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog dmar mo rnga zlum sgra sgrog cing*// rab tu mdzes ma rdo rje dril bu'i phyag /bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// murāñje/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog ljang khu rdza rnga'i sgra sgrog cing*// rab tu mdzes ma rdo rje dril bu'i phyag /bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// mṛ taṃ ge gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// bzhad ma dmar mo bzhad cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// rdo rje dril 'dzin snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// hā s+ya/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sgeg ma sngon mo sgeg cing 'gying pa'i gzugs// rdo rje dril 'dzin snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// lā s+ya/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// glu ma ljang khu sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// rdo rje dril 'dzin snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// gī ti/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// gar ma ser mo sgeg cing 'gying pa'i gzugs// rdo rje dril 'dzin snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// nṛ ti/

gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog dkar mo me tog pad+ma'i snod// rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// puṣ+pe/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog sngon mo bdug spos pad+ma'i snod// rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// dhu pe/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog dmar mo snang gsal pad+ma'i snod/ rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// ā lo ke gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// sku mdog ljang khu dri chab pad+ma'i snod// rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// gan+dhe/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// gzugs ma dkar mo me long pad+ma'i snod// rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// dār+she/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// ro ma dmar mo dung chos pad+ma'i snod// rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// ra s+ya/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// reg ma ser mo na bza' pad+ma'i snod// rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// par+she/ gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// chos ma sngon mo chos 'byung pad+ma'i snod// rab tu mdzes ma kha ṭūṃ ḍā ma ru// bde ba mchog gi dpal ldan dgyes par mdzod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharme hūm̐/ rigs lnga'i ngo bo bla ma la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ skyes mchog khyed kyi spangs pa dang*// ye shes che ba'i bdag nyid la// sangs rgyas lnga ru grags pa ste// phyag 'tshal dpal ldan bla ma la'o// gti mug chos dbyings ye shes che// dbyings phyug ma dang rnam rol zhing*// gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pa// phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la'o// zhes sdang me long ye shes che// mā ma ki dang rnam rol zhing*// rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa// phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la'o// nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes che// sangs rgyas spyan dang rnam rol zhing*// tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa// phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la'o// 'dod chags kun rtog ye shes che// gos dkar mo dang rnam rol zhing*// 'du shes phung po rnam dag pa// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la'o// phrag dog bya grub ye shes che// dam tshig sgrol dang rnam rol zhing*// 'du byed phung po rnam dag pa// phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o// rnam dag ye shes lnga dang ldan// phung po lnga la rnam rol zhing*// thabs shes zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// phyag 'tshal kun 'dus rdo rje la'o//

de nas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las byung ba ltar tshig tu brjod cing don bsgom pa ni/ e ma ho bde chen 'dod pa yis// sa gsum po ni gang ba ste// e ma ho zhi ba'i bde ba 'bab// sna tshogs mngon par byang chub rgyas// e ma ho bde ba'i bde chen po// rnam dag bde ba chen por yang dag shar// e ma ho ji lta ji ltar bza'// snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du bza'// e ma ho lhan skyes bdag nyid che// chos rnams kun gyi ngo bo nyid// 'gro ba chu zla bzhin du mthong ba dang*/ thos pa brag cha dang ni mtshungs par yang dag 'jug /sems kyang mya ngam smig sgyu lta bur blta bya zhing*// 'di ltar bza' dang btung ba nam mkha' lta bu ste// dri ni nam mkha'i me tog mtshungs pa'i rnam pa dang*// yid ni nyi ma zla ba bzhin du khyab par bya// yang dag gnas ni ri rab dang ni mtshungs pa yin// gzhon nu ma yi rmi lam ji bzhin rmi bar bya// tha snyad dag ni sgyu ma mig 'phrul lta bur brjod// 'di dag ji bzhin lhan skyes bde 'byung de bzhin te// srid pa'i rang bzhin bral zhing bsam gyis mi khyab gzugs// rtag tu 'char ba'i bde gshegs lam mchog phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// dag pa'i sems la ye shes nyi ma shar// shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i snang ba rgyas// sems nyid rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyun chad med par 'bab pa'i chu bo ltar// brtan pa'i sems la mnyam gzhag rjes thob med// 'phel 'grib med par bde ba'i nyams myong rgyas// sems nyid rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// ri bo mchog la g.yo 'gul med pa ltar// rtog pa'i rkyen gyis mi g.yo brtan pa thob// 'gyur med rgyun du gnas pa 'bras bu'i mchog /sems nyid rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma ho dpal ldan rin po che// e ma ho dam chos rin po che// e ma ho sems nyid rin po che// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod//

sku bzhi phrin las kyi 'char tshul la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mgon po khyod kyi sku gsung thugs// 'dus ma byas shing brjod du med// spros bral mkha' ltar dag pa po// phyag 'tshal gsang 'dus rdo rje la'o// dngos po kun las rnam grol zhing*// skye 'gag rtag chad mtha' dbus dang*// 'gro 'ong gnas pa mi mnga' ba'i// phyag 'tshal chos sku rdo rje la'o// skyes mchog dag pa'i zhing khams su// mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar bas// theg mchog yon tan spel mdzad pa'i// phyag 'tshal don yod rdo rje la'o// zhi dang khro bo'i skur ston cing*// gar gyi nyams dgu la sogs pas// 'khor gyi sems dpa' 'dul mdzad pa'i// phyag 'tshal longs sku rdo rje la'o// nyam thag 'gro ba skyabs pa'i phyir// sems can mos pa sna tshogs la// sna tshogs sku ni ston mdzad pa'i// phyag 'tshal thog med rdo rje la'o// sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las kyis// ji srid 'khor ba de srid du// 'gro don mnyam du mdzad pa po// phyag 'tshal sprul sku rdo rje la'o// sprin tshogs nam mkhar gcig pa bzhin// de bzhin rgyal ba'i gzugs sku yang*// chos sku'i ngang du gcig gyur pa'i// phyag 'tshal chos dbyings rdo rje la'o// chu klung rgya mtshor 'bab pa ltar// sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid kyang*// chos nyid rgya mtshor gshegs gyur pa'i// phyag 'tshal ngo bo nyid sku la'o// chos sku spros pa zhi gyur kyang*// mya ngan 'dam gyis ma gos pa// yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i dpal// phyag 'tshal 'byung gnas rdo rje la'o// gzugs sku 'khor bar bzhugs gyur kyang*// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa// chu zla bzhin du gsal ba'i sku// phyag 'tshal bde chen mchog khyod la'o// sangs rgyas sku lnga'i yon tan kun// rab tu rdzogs pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i// dpal ldan mi yi seng ge mchog /phyag 'tshal sangs rgyas rin chen la'o// mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// sgrib pa'i tshogs kun bsal gyur cing*// yon tan rgyud la bskyed mdzad pa'i// phyag 'tshal dpal ldan bla ma la'o//

mchod pa bcu gnyis smon lam dang sbyar nas 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma med pa'i chab// bkra shis sna tshogs 'o ma'i chu rgyun gyis// rgyal ba'i zhal la zhal bsil 'di phul bas// 'gro kun bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /spos dang tsan dan la sogs sbyor ba yi// las kun byed pa'i chu gtsang dam pa 'di// rgyal ba'i zhabs la zhabs bsil 'di phul bas// 'gro kun blo bur dri ma dag bar shog /chu skyes thang skyes yid las byung ba yi// byang chub yan lag mdzes pa'i me tog 'di// sbyin pa'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i dbu la 'bul// 'gro kun 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /lhan cig skyes dang yongs su sbyar ba yi// rab tu tshim byed bdug spos dam pa 'di// tshul khrims rang bzhin rgyal ba'i shangs la 'bul// 'gro kun dal 'byor yon tan rdzogs par shog /gsal zhing mi g.yo mdzes par snang ba yi// ma rig mun sel snang byed sgron me 'di// bzod pa'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i spyan la 'bul// 'gro kun mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs par shog /tsan+dan ga bur gur gum la sogs pa'i// rnam mang dri zhing byug pa dam pa 'di// brtson 'grus rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul// 'gro kun yon tan gong du 'phel bar shog /ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i zhal zas mchog /phun tshogs thams cad 'byung ba bdud rtsi'i rigs// bsam gtan rang bzhin rgyal ba'i ljags la 'bul// 'gro kun ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /yan lag lnga ldan rol mo sil snyan 'di// shes rab rang bzhin rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul// bsod nams 'di yis zag med chos rnams kun// 'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la 'char bar shog /dbang po tshim byed 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ phun sum tshogs pa mchog gi longs spyod rnams// thabs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// 'gro kun zag med phung po lnga thob shog /zhing skyes sngags skyes rang bzhin lhan cig skyes// yid las byung ba sprul pa lha mo'i tshogs// stobs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba'i gzugs mar 'bul/

'gro ba kun gyi bde ba mchog thob shog rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus dge ba'i tshogs/ dwangs ba'i yid kyi bskul zhing brjod pa 'di/ smon lam rang bzhin rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas yon tan thob par shog /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// yang dag par ni mnyam par bzhag pa'i don// ye shes rang bzhin rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul// 'gro ba kun gyis chos nyid don rtogs shog/ chen po bcu gnyis yon tan mtha' dag gi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ snying rje chen po sems chen po// dmigs pa chen po blo chen po// go cha chen po mtshon chen po// dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dad pa chen po gus chen po// dam tshig chen po brtul bzhugs che// brtson 'grus chen po stobs chen po// skyes chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes rab chen po thabs chen po// bde ba chen po gsal ba che// stong pa chen po rgya chen po// thub chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// theg pa chen po sa chen po// lam chen ye shes chen po ste// yon tan chen po snyan grags che// rgyal chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhing khams chen po snang ba che// rdzu 'phrul chen po gdul bya che// byin rlabs chen po don chen po// skyabs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku chen gzi brjid chen po pa/ gsung dbyangs chen po 'od chen po/ mkhyen pa chen po mthu chen po/ dpal chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ 'khor lo chen po ral gri che/ rdo rje chen po pad+ma che/ lcags kyu chen po zhags pa che// rigs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang phyug chen po 'byung gnas che// dpags bsam shing chen bum pa che// nor bu chen po gter chen po// rin chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyi ma chen po zla ba che// rgya mtsho chen po nam mkha' che// ri bo chen po sa chen po// khyab chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mnyan pa chen po gru chen po// sman pa chen po bdud rtsi che// phrin las chen po bde legs che// lha chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan bla ma thams cad mkhyen// 'gro ba'i ston pa rdo rje'i sgras// sems can khams ni sad mdzad pa'i// snang chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron// thugs rje'i zla ba bdud rtsi'i 'od// kun gyi bdag nyid 'byung gnas dpal// che mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//

sdig pa bshags pa sogs bya ba ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pas// nyon mongs dbang gis kun nas blangs gyur te// lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// skyes mchog khyod kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags// skyes mchog rin chen sras dang bcas rnams dang*// lam du zhugs dang bsgrub pa byed la sogs// dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed mdzad kun la// de dag kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*// mos pa'i bye brag gdul bya sna tshogs la// gang la gang 'dul de yi skur bstan nas// theg pa sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo rin chen bskor du gsol// chos sku spros pa ma lus zhi gyur kyang*// thugs rje chen pos gdul bya'i snang ba la// ji srid 'khor ba de srid gzugs sku'i tshogs// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// so so thar dang de bzhin byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa de dag kun// skyes mchog khyed kyi spyan sngar bdag len cing*// rim pa bzhin du bdag gis brten par bgyi// bslab par bya ba'i chos rnams thams cad la// bsam pa'i thabs dang rtogs pa'i stobs dag gis// don chen bsgrub pa'i bya ba ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba'i bka' las nam yang mi 'da' 'o// thun mong khyad par dam tshig sdom pa dang*// 'gal bar gyur pa'i nyes pa ma lus kun// mgon po khyod kyi spyan sngar bdag bshags na// thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs su gsol// skyes mchog khyod kyi thugs rje'i byin brlabs kyis// log pa'i bsam pa nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// nyon mongs rtog pa'i tshogs kun zhi nas kyang*// dkar po'i yon tan gong du 'phel bar shog /bla ma bsten cing dkon mchog mchod pa la// mos gus ltem kyang nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// theg mchog lam gyi sgrub pa byed pa'i tshe// skad cig tsam yang le lo med par shog /bsdu ba bzhi dang zhi sogs las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par byed 'gyur zhing*// sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i don rnams kun// de dag thams cad bdag gis 'grub par shog

/'gro ba'i don la skyo ba med pa dang*// lus dang longs spyod dngos po thams cad la// 'dzin chags ser sna nam yang mi 'byung zhing*// zad mi shes par kun la gtong bar shog /dge ba 'di yis mkha' mnyam sems can gyi// sdig dang sgrib pa'i tshogs kun byang gyur te// bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur nas// bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog /bdag blo gti mug rmongs pa'i dbang gyur te/ legs spyad 'di la nyes par gyur pa gang*/ skyes mchog rin chen rnams dang de yi sras/ bdag nyid chen po khyed la bzod par gsol/ khyed kyi thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don kun mdzad/ thun mong mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang du gshegs nas kyang*/ gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don la 'byon par zhu// nyes byas dri ma'i tshogs kun byang ba dang*// bsod nams yon tan spel bar 'dod pa dang*// bdud dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa dang*// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par 'dod rnams kyis// bla ma mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i thabs// 'di nyid nan tan mchog tu bya'o zhes// rdo rje 'chang gis rgya cher gsungs pas na// blo ldan rnams kyis 'di la 'bad par rigs// bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa dag /sbyar ba de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro ba 'di kun yang dag bla ma yis// rjes su bzung nas bde chen thob par shog/ //
